# Github stats for biojulia repos

```{julia}
includet("gh-module.jl")
using .GHInfo
using DataFrames
using Dates
using CairoMakie
```

```{julia}
stars = DataFrame()
for repo in ("BioSequences.jl", "Automa.jl", "BioStructures.jl", "SingleCellProjections.jl")
    df = monthly_star_history("BioJulia/$repo")
    df.repo .= repo
    append!(stars, df)
end
```

```{julia}
fig = Figure(; size=(800,400));
ax = Axis(fig[1,1]; ylabel="Github stars", xlabel="date")

for sdf in groupby(stars, "repo")
    scatterlines!(ax, sdf.month, sdf.cumulative, label=first(sdf.repo))
end
Legend(fig[1,2], ax)

save("../images/stars.svg", fig)
fig
```

```{julia}
stats = org_repos("BioJulia")
sort!(stats, "stars"; rev=true)
```

```{julia}
stats_keep = subset(stats, ["archived", "pushed", "last_release_date"] => ByRow((a, p, l)-> begin
    a && return false
    ismissing(l) && return false
    (today() - p) < Day(365*3)
end))

```

```{julia}
fig2 = Figure(; size=(800,400));
ax1 = Axis(fig2[1,1]; xlabel="stars", ylabel="repos")
ax2 = Axis(fig2[1,2]; xlabel="open issues", ylabel="repos")
ax3 = Axis(fig2[2,1]; xlabel="days since last commit", ylabel="repos")
ax4 = Axis(fig2[2,2]; xlabel="days since last release", ylabel="repos")
ax5 = Axis(fig2[1:2,3]; ylabel="repos", xticks=([1,2],["v0.x", "v1.0+"]))

hist!(ax1, stats_keep.stars, bins=8)
hist!(ax2, stats_keep.open_issues, bins=8)
hist!(ax3, getproperty.(Day.(today() .- stats_keep.pushed), :value), bins=8)
hist!(ax4, getproperty.(Day.(today() .- stats_keep.last_release_date), :value), bins=8)
let
    unstable = count(v-> startswith(v, "v0"), stats_keep.last_release)
    stable = nrow(stats_keep) - unstable
    barplot!(ax5, [unstable, stable])
end

Label(fig2[0,:], "Active Repos with commits in the last 3 years")
save("../images/repostats.svg", fig2)
fig2
```

```{julia}
commits = commit_table("BioJulia", stats_keep.name, today() - Year(3))   # repo_names from org_repos().name
```

```{julia}
# commits per committer (across the org)
per_committer = combine(groupby(commits, :committer), nrow => :commits)
sort!(per_committer, :commits, rev=true)

n_active = nrow(per_committer)   # number of active committers in the window
```

```{julia}
fig3,ax,hst = hist(per_committer.commits; axis=(; ylabel="number of commits", xlabel="committers"), figure=(; size=(800, 400)))

targets = [(23, 1), (430, 1), (365, 1)]
labels  = ["Me!", "Rasmus", "Jakob"]   # your text
dx, dy = 20, 4
signs = [-1, +1, +1]

for ((x, y), s, lbl) in zip(targets, signs, labels)
    tail = (x - s*dx, y + dy)
    arrows!(ax, [tail[1]], [tail[2]], [s*dx], [-dy])
    text!(ax, tail...; text=lbl,
          align = s < 0 ? (:left, :bottom) : (:right, :bottom),
          offset = (s*4, 2))
end
Label(fig3[0,1], "$(n_active) commiters in the last 3 years"; tellwidth=false)
save("../images/commiters.svg", fig3)
fig3
```
